from pathlib import Path
from html.parser import HTMLParser
import re
page = Path('landing/index.html').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
class Check(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.ids = set()
        self.links = []
        self.h1 = 0
        self.scripts = 0
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        values = dict(attrs)
        if 'id' in values:
            assert values['id'] not in self.ids, 'Duplicate id'
            self.ids.add(values['id'])
        if tag == 'a': self.links.append(values.get('href', ''))
        if tag == 'h1': self.h1 += 1
        if tag == 'script': self.scripts += 1
check = Check()
check.feed(page)
